Microsoft 365 Licensing Review

This report summarises licence products, seats in use and available, subscription lifecycle dates, and the users holding each licence for the selected tenant.

Review available seats against demand and commitment terms; verify renewal and trial dates with your CSP; and check assignments on departed, disabled or service accounts. Seat counts are summed across products and do not equal a count of distinct people. Available seats are not automatically refundable.

CIPP estimates some NCE dates, so confirm them in your CSP portal. The user assignment section displays up to 500 users.
